"""
Calculate surface energy from bulk and slab energies
"""

E_bulk = -1679.86275358002  # eV
E_slab = -1631.81097249017  # eV
N_bulk = 500  # atoms
N_slab = 500  # atoms

# Box dimensions (from LAMMPS data files)
Lx = 20.19465  # Angstrom
Ly = 20.19465  # Angstrom

# Calculate surface area
A = Lx * Ly  # Angstrom^2

# Calculate surface energy

# gamma = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2 * A)

gamma = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2 * A)

print(f"Bulk energy: {E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Slab energy: {E_slab} eV")
print(f"Energy difference: {E_slab - E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Number of atoms (bulk): {N_bulk}")

print(f"Surface area: {A:.6f} Å²")
print(f"Surface energy: {gamma:.6f} eV/Å²")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {gamma:.2f}")
